title: THE LAUNDROMAT AT THE END OF OXYGEN
deck: A charged dust front will reach the mining moon of Kestrel in six hours. Ninety-three pressure suits need their filters stripped and washed, but the settlement's only recycler is locked against families whose employers called industrial dust a household debt. Illuminara must keep everyone breathing without destroying the livelihood of the frightened man who owns the machines.
shape: Six scenes across one emergency night: excluded residents at a locked laundromat; the owner naming the broken promises and exact membrane shortfall behind his ledger; a failed recovery test whose clue leads residents and miners to a shared plasma process; a mine representative verifying the dust source himself; the owner receiving a concrete answer for his daughter's treatment and voluntarily surrendering the lock before a contested utility vote; and the morning after the front, when all ninety-three suits are clean and the laundromat reopens as an accountable resident utility.

scenes.title: The Locked Wash
paragraphs: *Venn Water and Wash, Kestrel settlement · 18:07, five hours fifty-three minutes before the dust front*

The laundromat stood at the end of the settlement's oxygen line. Behind its locked glass, twelve silver drums cleaned their own pipes while ninety-three pressure suits waited outside in red emergency sacks.
A sign read SERVICE SUSPENDED FOR ACCOUNTS IN ARREARS. Someone had written PEOPLE ARE NOT ACCOUNTS beneath it. Jaro Venn had wiped away the word PEOPLE and left the rest.
Sela Moru held the hand of a boy whose filter alarm chirped every twelve seconds. Families kept their helmets under their arms to save cartridge life.

**Sela**  
The front is charged. If this grit reaches the seals, we cannot shelter in our own suits.
Jaro answered through the grille. He was sleepless and wore a technician's apron, not a creditor's coat.

**Jaro**  
Four batches will clean ninety-three suits. Each batch needs four membrane charges. I have fourteen. We need sixteen before we even ask what the shop uses next week.

**Sela**  
Then wash the children first.

**Jaro**  
And choose which adults lose the last two charges? I have done that arithmetic every night.

Illuminara entered with empty hands. She did not face the lock first. She knelt beside Jaro's daughter Lio, who sat inside with a torn sleeve ring across her lap. Twice she had stitched it; twice the thread had pulled loose.

**Illuminara**  
May I hold the ring while you stitch? You know where it pulls.
Lio looked to her father. Jaro opened the service hatch just far enough to pass the sleeve through.

**Lio**  
It pulls when I reach for the upper valves.
Illuminara held the ring against the glass while Lio guided the fibre. She warmed the seal only as much as the cloth required. The third stitch lay flat.
Lio grinned. Sela tapped the debt sign.

**Sela**  
A mended sleeve is not ninety-three clean suits.

**Illuminara**  
No. And breaking this door does not create the two missing charges.

**Sela**  
Do not make his lock sound merciful.

**Illuminara**  
It is not. I am naming the constraint, not forgiving what he did with it.
She turned to Jaro.

**Illuminara**  
Show us the membranes, the debts and the promises that left you carrying someone else's cost. You may still refuse what I propose. So may they.
Jaro looked at Lio's mended sleeve, then unlocked only the maintenance door.

**Jaro**  
Forty minutes. Nobody touches a drum until I say it is safe.

scenes.title: The Price of Kindness
paragraphs: *Venn Water and Wash, membrane room · 18:29, five hours thirty-one minutes before the dust front*
Fourteen translucent sheets hung in a dry cabinet. On Jaro's batch board, four boxes stood for each wash. The last two boxes were empty: sixteen charge-cycles required, fourteen available.
Beside the board lay two unpaid public contracts: one from a dissolved council, one from a mining insurer that had renamed industrial contamination personal maintenance.

**Jaro**  
I opened free for eleven weeks. Then the clinic said Lio's lung treatment required a deposit. Praise did not clear at the bank.

**Sela**  
So you put the deposit on our doors.

**Jaro**  
I put unpaid washes on the ledger. The mine put the dust there first. You came to my counter, not theirs.

**Sela**  
Because your counter is where the door is.
Lio sorted discarded suit filters by colour. Illuminara asked before lifting one. Bright grains remained in the blue-grey inner weave.

**Illuminara**  
What stains the rinse water green?

**Lio**  
These filters. And the trays from the bearing bay. They make the same green line when I deliver Father's seals.
Jaro placed a fibre under the shop spectrometer. Its silver-cobalt catalyst was active; copper sulphide and skin oil bound it.

**Illuminara**  
The catalyst is not spent. It is trapped. Jaro, what did acid do?

**Jaro**  
Dissolved the carrier, poisoned the water and cost me two membranes.

**Illuminara**  
Then no acid. Who on Kestrel removes copper sulphide from precision surfaces without it?
Lio pointed downline before Jaro answered.

**Lio**  
The bearing bay. Their trays come back clean.

**Jaro**  
Low-pressure plasma. The unit never leaves the mine.

**Illuminara**  
It may not need to. First we test one strip here. One litre, your stop signal, and no emergency suit in a drum.
Sela pointed to the two empty boxes on the board.

**Sela**  
If it works, does it fill those?

**Jaro**  
Three recovered charges would fill them and leave one spare. If it fails, we lose water and time.

**Sela**  
One strip. The children's suits stay sealed until we know.

scenes.title: The First Membrane
paragraphs: *Venn Water and Wash, test drum · 19:04, four hours fifty-six minutes before the dust front*

Jaro cut a square from a condemned sheet. Lio weighed spent filter cloth. Sela watched the emergency gauge. Illuminara changed the sequence of the machines already there: steam for oil, a charged mesh for catalyst, warm pressure for adhesion.
The first two passes ran clear. On the third, a dark vein opened. The strip split, green water struck the wall and the gauge fell by eighty-two litres before Jaro closed the manual valve.
Illuminara caught the loose housing before it crushed the drain manifold, then stepped away from Jaro's valve.

**Jaro**  
Stop. No more cloth. No more tests.

**Illuminara**  
Stopped.
No one called the failure progress. Eighty-two litres pooled behind glass, contaminated until slow reclamation.

**Sela**  
That was six suit washes.

**Jaro**  
And four minutes we do not have.
Illuminara studied the torn edge. Catalyst had adhered, but sharp sulphide crystals had cut the pore lattice.

**Illuminara**  
Lio's clue was right. The bearing bay cleans the grain our steam leaves behind. We take the cloth to the plasma unit, not the unit to us.

**Jaro**  
If their cleaned grain still cuts a sheet, we stop after one pass.
Sela's son's alarm shortened to nine seconds.

**Jaro**  
Take one of Lio's spares. The blue case.
Lio flinched, then brought it herself.

**Lio**  
It has four hours. His has less than three.
Sela accepted it without softening.

**Illuminara**  
Jaro, name the inventory limit at the mine. Sela, name who has borne the damage. I can carry this housing. I cannot make their consent or yours.
Jaro folded his apron over Lio's crate.

**Jaro**  
Lio runs the shop interlock. If she closes it, we all stop.

**Lio**  
I know where it pulls.

scenes.title: Who Made the Dust
paragraphs: *Kestrel Mining Cooperative, bearing bay · 20:02, three hours fifty-eight minutes before the dust front*
Niko Arendt met them beneath the plasma unit. He represented the miners, not the export company. His left sleeve carried three repair patches.

**Niko**  
If that unit leaves the bay, six crawlers stop. Their crews shelter underground and the settlement loses a month of food credit.

**Sela**  
Our children shelter in suits your dust has eaten.

**Niko**  
It is everyone's dust. We live on the same moon.
Jaro laid the torn strip on Niko's bench.

**Jaro**  
The moon's silicate is pale. These black sulphides come from your solvent line.

**Illuminara**  
Do not take my conclusion. Check it. Which patch was fitted after your last solvent purge?

Niko chose the newest sleeve patch, brushed its seam onto a slide and ran his own spectrometer. The display matched Jaro's filter grain and the bearing tray residue: copper sulphide, the export line's stabiliser and no lunar silicate.
He ran it again with a blank slide. The match remained.

**Niko**  
Not everyone's dust.
He looked at his crawler board.

**Niko**  
Seventy minutes without this unit. After that crawler seven reaches its threshold.

**Illuminara**  
Then the unit stays. Clean catalyst here for sixty minutes. Jaro tunes one charge on your bench. Residents carry finished trays through the inner tunnel. You or Lio may stop the process.

**Niko**  
That solves tonight. Tomorrow the company fines this shift for helping a private debtor.

**Sela**  
And tomorrow our accounts still say we chose your dust.
Jaro faced her.

**Jaro**  
I knew that classification was false. I collected anyway because the clinic would stop Lio's treatment.

**Sela**  
Understanding why does not return the air we rationed.

**Jaro**  
No.
Illuminara looked to Jaro.

**Illuminara**  
Lio carried seal trays through this bay. You told us about Friday’s clinic deposit. May I name the route and injury code to Niko?
Jaro held the torn strip.

**Jaro**  
The route and injury code. Not her records. Lio decides whether her name is spoken.
Lio answered through the shop link.

**Lio**  
Use my name. I carried twelve trays last month through this bay.
Niko checked the route log and Lio’s exposure code. Both named the solvent line.
Illuminara placed the two empty batch boxes beside Niko's spectrum.

**Illuminara**  
Tonight needs two recovered charges and one spare. Tomorrow needs honest damage allocation. Will the cooperative advance the audited membrane order from its maintenance reserve while it files this spectrum against the export company?
Niko kept one hand on the red stop bar.

**Niko**  
My crews vote before the first full sheet. If they refuse, the unit returns to bearings.

**Jaro**  
Start with the torn edge. It will fail before we spend a sheet if our answer is wrong.
The plasma made a violet skin over the cloth. Niko cleaned it, Jaro pressed it, and Lio watched the voltage trace from the shop. Five passes held. The first empty box on Jaro's board turned blue.

scenes.title: The Key and the Vote
paragraphs: *Venn Water and Wash, public corridor · 21:18, two hours forty-two minutes before the dust front*
The miners had approved the reserve advance, but one mechanic named Pell stood before the corridor camera with his no vote visible.

**Pell**  
The spectrum proves the dust. It does not prove the export company will repay us. I will work the plasma line, but I will not pretend the reserve is safe.

**Niko**  
Your objection stays in the record.
Before the residents voted, Jaro kept the door shut.

**Jaro**  
If I surrender the lock, what happens when the clinic asks for Lio's deposit on Friday? Not eventually. Friday.
Niko set the signed spectrum beside the reserve order.

**Niko**  
Her diagnosed lung damage is part of the same dust claim. With your consent, the cooperative fronts the deposit from the hazard reserve and files the clinic invoice against the export line. It is not charity and it is not payment for your yes.

**Sela**  
And it does not erase what you did. It stops your child from being collateral for what they did.
Jaro looked at Lio. She had one hand on the interlock and the other inside her mended sleeve.

**Jaro**  
Then I give the utility the door, the drums and the debt ledger. I ask for paid work under the same safety rules as anyone else. I do not ask Sela to forgive me.
He removed the physical override key from his apron and placed it in Lio's palm. Lio opened the main door before the first ballot was counted.

The residents approved the utility; seven families abstained pending legal review. Sela voted yes to retain Jaro’s technical work and wrote NOT FORGIVEN beside it. Pell’s no vote remained on the same record.
Lio took down the debt sign and placed it face down under the counter as evidence.

The recovered catalyst supplied three extra charges: the two missing from Jaro's board and one spare. Residents formed inspection, wash and seal lines. Niko's crews sent numbered trays through the pressure tunnel.
At 22:11 the active charge lost voltage.

**Jaro**  
Stop all drums.

Lio closed the interlock. Every drum halted before contaminated water crossed a seal. Pell stood at the public board and read the trace aloud while Jaro and Lio replaced the failed charge with the single recovered spare.

**Pell**  
The stop worked. The spare is the seventeenth charge, and now there is no eighteenth. I still oppose the reserve advance. I verify this trace.
The four batches remained covered, with no unused charge left.
Lio carried the seam lamp along the queue. At each knee she made the wearer bend, turn and reach for an imaginary upper valve.

Illuminara worked at the dirtiest drum. When a precursor charge gust struck, she held the exhaust manifold long enough for Jaro to brace it. Her strength kept the pipe from tearing; it did not change the public queue.

At 22:46 Sela’s son’s suit cleared, and he returned the blue spare to Lio before its four-hour reserve expired. At 23:41 suit eighty-eight cleared. The final five belonged to adults who had given newer cartridges to children.
Jaro lifted the last sack and found Sela's name.

**Jaro**  
Your account was the first I locked.

**Sela**  
Then wash it because it is next, not because you need release from me.

**Jaro**  
Because it is next.

At 23:56 the ninety-third suit passed pressure. The front struck four minutes later. Families sheltered in clean suits while Jaro stood beside the manual stop, Sela beside the queue, Niko beside the crawler board and Lio beside the utility key.

scenes.title: What the Morning Owned
paragraphs: *Kestrel settlement, outside Venn Water and Wash · 07:32, after the dust front*

The front stripped paint from the mine-facing walls and buried the garden under grey grit. No one in the corridor lost pressure. Ninety-three suits hung tagged clean, repaired and owned by the people who wore them.

No unused charge-cycle remained after the 22:11 swap: all seventeen had been accounted for on the public board. Decorative water stayed suspended for fourteen days while the lost eighty-two litres entered slow reclamation. The failed test stayed in the ledger beside the result it had purchased.

Niko brought the dust-liability filing and the clinic's receipt for Lio's deposit. The cooperative had frozen the household classification and opened a measurement claim against the export company. Arbitration remained unresolved.

**Niko**  
They call one spectrum inconclusive.

**Sela**  
Then give them every shift.

**Niko**  
We started at dawn.
The residents' board offered Jaro a one-year operator contract, removable for safety misconduct or exclusion and paid from utility revenue rather than household debt.

**Jaro**  
The machines are not mine.

**Sela**  
Your skill is. We are paying for it.
The old debt file remained as evidence, but every household balance was zero. Medical records had been removed before audit.

**Sela**  
It remembers what happened. It no longer decides who breathes.
Jaro signed. He did not ask for a handshake.
Lio switched on drum one for the clinic wash. The control panel showed WATER, MEMBRANE, DUST SOURCE and QUEUE. No line read DESERVING.

**Lio**  
The sleeve still pulls at the upper valve.

**Illuminara**  
The third stitch solved the tear, not the reach.
This time Sela held the ring. Lio added a crescent of flexible cloth while Jaro watched without correcting her hands. When she reached up, the sleeve moved with her.
Outside, residents cleared the garden with dry brushes while arbitration notices gathered under the open door.
Illuminara left as the first ordinary wash turned. Behind her, the door stayed open; Sela held the sleeve ring while Lio reached the upper valve without the new crescent pulling.

critic_line: Illuminara reads a failed test to find a gentler way, asks a father and his daughter for leave to speak what only they can tell, and a locked laundromat becomes an open utility with ninety-three clean suits before the dust arrives.

shared_strengths: Humane, dialogue-heavy premise with a ticking clock and a morally nuanced antagonist, and no cheap forgiveness. But the technical chemistry, charge counts and timestamps are dense and procedural. The resolution is orderly, and the story reads more as a case study than as emotional drama.

The distinctive life-or-death laundromat premise, compassionate conflicts, and dialogue-led problem solving strongly fit these readers. The carefully preserved consent, accountability, and procedural nuance are memorable, though the moral positions and engineered resolution sometimes feel overly explicit and schematic, slightly weakening immersion and recommendation enthusiasm.
shared_reservations: Jaro placed a fibre under the shop spectrometer. Its silver-cobalt catalyst was active; copper sulphide and skin oil bound it.

translation_sl.title: PRALNICA NA KONCU KISIKA
translation_sl.deck: Čez šest ur bo rudarsko luno Kestrel dosegel naelektren prašni vihar. S triindevetdesetih tlačnih oblek je treba sneti in oprati filtre, toda edini naselbinski reciklator je zaklenjen za družine, katerih delodajalci so industrijski prah razglasili za gospodinjski dolg. Illuminara mora vsem ohraniti zrak, ne da bi uničila preživetje prestrašenega moža, ki ima stroje v lasti.
translation_sl.shape: Šest prizorov v eni noči izrednih razmer: izključeni prebivalci pred zaklenjeno pralnico; lastnik, ki poimenuje prelomljene obljube in natančno pomanjkanje membran za svojo knjigo dolgov; neuspel preizkus obnove, katerega sled prebivalce in rudarje pripelje do skupnega plazemskega postopka; predstavnik rudnika, ki sam preveri izvor prahu; lastnik, ki prejme konkreten odgovor za zdravljenje svoje hčere in se pred spornim glasovanjem o javni službi prostovoljno odpove ključavnici; ter jutro po viharju, ko je vseh triindevetdeset oblek čistih in se pralnica ponovno odpre kot odgovorna javna služba prebivalcev.

scenes.title: Zaklenjeno pranje
paragraphs: *Vennova voda in pranje, naselbina Kestrel · 18:07, pet ur in triinpetdeset minut pred prašnim viharjem*

Pralnica je stala na koncu naselbinskega kisikovega voda. Za njenim zaklenjenim steklom je dvanajst srebrnih bobnov čistilo lastne cevi, zunaj pa je v rdečih vrečah za nujne primere čakalo triindevetdeset tlačnih oblek.
Na napisu je pisalo STORITEV USTAVLJENA ZA RAČUNE V ZAOSTANKU. Nekdo je pod to napisal LJUDJE NISO RAČUNI. Jaro Venn je zbrisal besedo LJUDJE in pustil preostalo.
Sela Moru je držala za roko dečka, čigar alarm filtra je zacvrčal vsakih dvanajst sekund. Družine so čelade držale pod rokami, da bi varčevale z življenjsko dobo vložkov.

**Sela**  
Vihar je naelektren. Če ta pesek doseže tesnila, se ne bomo mogli zateči niti v lastne obleke.
Jaro je odgovoril skozi rešetko. Bil je neprespan in nosil je predpasnik tehnika, ne plašča upnika.

**Jaro**  
Štiri serije bodo očistile triindevetdeset oblek. Vsaka serija potrebuje štiri membranske naboje. Imam jih štirinajst. Potrebujemo jih šestnajst, še preden se vprašamo, kaj bo trgovina uporabljala prihodnji teden.

**Sela**  
Potem najprej operi otroške.

**Jaro**  
In naj izberem, kateri odrasli izgubijo zadnja dva naboja? To računico opravljam vsako noč.

Illuminara je vstopila praznih rok. Ni se najprej obrnila proti ključavnici. Pokleknila je ob Jarovi hčeri Lio, ki je sedela znotraj in imela čez naročje raztrgan obroč rokava. Dvakrat ga je zašila; dvakrat se je nit izpulila.

**Illuminara**  
Lahko držim obroč, medtem ko šivaš? Ti veš, kje vleče.
Lio je pogledala očeta. Jaro je odprl servisno loputo ravno toliko, da je skoznjo podal rokav.

**Lio**  
Vleče, ko se stegnem proti zgornjim ventilom.
Illuminara je obroč držala ob steklu, medtem ko je Lio vodila vlakno. Tesnilo je ogrela le toliko, kolikor je zahtevalo blago. Tretji šiv je ležal ravno.
Lio se je nasmehnila. Sela je potrkala po napisu o dolgu.

**Sela**  
Zakrpani rokav ni triindevetdeset čistih oblek.

**Illuminara**  
Ne. Tudi razbitje teh vrat ne ustvari dveh manjkajočih nabojev.

**Sela**  
Ne govori, kakor da je njegova ključavnica usmiljena.

**Illuminara**  
Ni. Poimenujem omejitev, ne odpuščam mu tega, kar je z njo storil.
Obrnila se je k Jaru.

**Illuminara**  
Pokaži nam membrane, dolgove in obljube, zaradi katerih nosiš strošek nekoga drugega. Še vedno lahko zavrneš, kar bom predlagala. Tudi oni lahko.
Jaro je pogledal Lijin zakrpani rokav, nato pa odklenil samo vzdrževalna vrata.

**Jaro**  
Štirideset minut. Nihče se ne dotakne bobna, dokler ne rečem, da je varno.

scenes.title: Cena dobrote
paragraphs: *Vennova voda in pranje, prostor za membrane · 18:29, pet ur in enaintrideset minut pred prašnim viharjem*

V suhi omari je viselo štirinajst prosojnih plošč. Na Jarovi tabli serij so bila za vsako pranje štiri polja. Zadnji dve sta bili prazni: potrebnih je bilo šestnajst ciklov naboja, na voljo jih je bilo štirinajst.
Ob tabli sta ležali dve neplačani javni pogodbi: ena razpuščenega sveta, druga rudarske zavarovalnice, ki je industrijsko onesnaženje preimenovala v osebno vzdrževanje.

**Jaro**  
Enajst tednov sem pral brezplačno. Potem je klinika rekla, da Lijino zdravljenje pljuč zahteva polog. Pohvala se na banki ni unovčila.

**Sela**  
Zato si polog obesil na naša vrata.

**Jaro**  
Neplačana pranja sem vpisal v knjigo. Rudnik je tja prvi poslal prah. Prišli ste k mojemu pultu, ne k njihovemu.

**Sela**  
Ker so vrata pri tvojem pultu.
Lio je zavržene filtre oblek razvrščala po barvah. Illuminara je vprašala, preden je enega dvignila. V modrosivem notranjem tkanju so ostala svetla zrnca.

**Illuminara**  
Kaj obarva vodo za izpiranje zeleno?

**Lio**  
Ti filtri. In pladnji iz ležajnega oddelka. Ko očetu dostavim tesnila, pustijo enako zeleno črto.
Jaro je vlakno položil pod spektrometer v delavnici. Njegov srebrno-kobaltni katalizator je bil dejaven; vezala sta ga bakrov sulfid in kožna maščoba.

**Illuminara**  
Katalizator ni izrabljen. Ujet je. Jaro, kaj je naredila kislina?

**Jaro**  
Raztopila je nosilec, zastrupila vodo in me stala dve membrani.

**Illuminara**  
Potem brez kisline. Kdo na Kestrelu odstranjuje bakrov sulfid z natančnih površin brez nje?
Lio je pokazala po vodu navzdol, še preden je Jaro odgovoril.

**Lio**  
Ležajni oddelek. Njihovi pladnji se vračajo čisti.

**Jaro**  
Nizkotlačna plazma. Naprava nikoli ne zapusti rudnika.

**Illuminara**  
Morda ji ne bo treba. Najprej tukaj preizkusimo en trak. En liter, tvoj znak za ustavitev in nobene obleke za nujne primere v bobnu.
Sela je pokazala na prazni polji na tabli.

**Sela**  
Če uspe, ju bo zapolnilo?

**Jaro**  
Trije obnovljeni naboji bi ju zapolnili in pustili enega rezervnega. Če spodleti, izgubimo vodo in čas.

**Sela**  
En trak. Otroške obleke ostanejo zapečatene, dokler ne bomo vedeli.

scenes.title: Prva membrana
paragraphs: *Vennova voda in pranje, preizkusni boben · 19:04, štiri ure in šestinpetdeset minut pred prašnim viharjem*

Jaro je iz odpisane plošče izrezal kvadrat. Lio je stehtala izrabljeno filtrsko tkanino. Sela je opazovala merilnik za nujne primere. Illuminara je spremenila zaporedje strojev, ki so že bili tam: para za maščobo, naelektrena mreža za katalizator, topel pritisk za oprijem.

Prva dva prehoda sta tekla čista. Pri tretjem se je odprla temna žila. Trak se je razcepil, zelena voda je udarila ob steno, merilnik pa je padel za dvainosemdeset litrov, preden je Jaro zaprl ročni ventil.
Illuminara je ujela razrahljano ohišje, preden je zdrobilo odtočni razdelilnik, nato pa stopila stran od Jarovega ventila.

**Jaro**  
Ustavite. Nobene tkanine več. Nobenih preizkusov več.

**Illuminara**  
Ustavljeno.
Nihče ni neuspeha imenoval napredek. Za steklom se je nabralo dvainosemdeset litrov, onesnaženih do počasne predelave.

**Sela**  
To je bilo šest pranj oblek.

**Jaro**  
In štiri minute, ki jih nimamo.
Illuminara je preučila raztrgani rob. Katalizator se je oprijel, toda ostri sulfidni kristali so prerezali mrežo por.

**Illuminara**  
Lijina sled je bila prava. Ležajni oddelek očisti zrnca, ki jih naša para pusti za seboj. Tkanino odnesemo do plazemske naprave, ne naprave k nam.

**Jaro**  
Če bo njihovo očiščeno zrno še vedno rezalo ploščo, se ustavimo po enem prehodu.
Alarm Selinega sina se je skrajšal na devet sekund.

**Jaro**  
Vzemi eno od Lijinih rezerv. Modri kovček.
Lio je trznila, nato ga je prinesla sama.

**Lio**  
Ima štiri ure. Njegov ima manj kot tri.
Sela ga je sprejela, ne da bi se omehčala.

**Illuminara**  
Jaro, povej omejitev zaloge v rudniku. Sela, povej, kdo je nosil škodo. To ohišje lahko nesem. Ne morem ustvariti njihovega soglasja ali vajinega.
Jaro je prepognil predpasnik čez Lijin zaboj.

**Jaro**  
Lio upravlja varnostno zaporo delavnice. Če jo zapre, se vsi ustavimo.

**Lio**  
Vem, kje vleče.

scenes.title: Kdo je ustvaril prah
paragraphs: *Rudarska zadruga Kestrel, ležajni oddelek · 20:02, tri ure in oseminpetdeset minut pred prašnim viharjem*
Niko Arendt jih je pričakal pod plazemsko napravo. Zastopal je rudarje, ne izvoznega podjetja. Na levem rokavu je imel tri zaplate.

**Niko**  
Če ta naprava zapusti oddelek, se ustavi šest goseničarjev. Njihove posadke se zatečejo pod zemljo, naselbina pa izgubi za mesec dni dobroimetja za hrano.

**Sela**  
Naši otroci se zatekajo v obleke, ki jih je požrl vaš prah.

**Niko**  
To je prah vseh. Živimo na isti luni.
Jaro je raztrgani trak položil na Nikovo delovno mizo.

**Jaro**  
Lunin silikat je svetel. Ti črni sulfidi prihajajo iz vaše linije topil.

**Illuminara**  
Ne sprejmi mojega sklepa. Preveri ga. Katera zaplata je bila nameščena po vašem zadnjem spiranju topila?

Niko je izbral najnovejšo zaplato na rokavu, njen šiv skrtačil na stekelce in ga analiziral z lastnim spektrometrom. Prikaz se je ujemal z zrnom iz Jarovega filtra in ostankom na ležajnem pladnju: bakrov sulfid, stabilizator izvozne linije in nič luninega silikata.
Analizo je ponovil s praznim stekelcem. Ujemanje je ostalo.

**Niko**  
Ni prah vseh.
Pogledal je tablo goseničarjev.

**Niko**  
Sedemdeset minut brez te naprave. Potem sedmi goseničar doseže svojo mejo.

**Illuminara**  
Potem naprava ostane. Tukaj šestdeset minut čistite katalizator. Jaro na vaši mizi nastavi en naboj. Prebivalci odnašajo končane pladnje skozi notranji predor. Ti ali Lio lahko postopek ustavita.

**Niko**  
To reši nocoj. Jutri bo podjetje kaznovalo to izmeno, ker je pomagala zasebnemu dolžniku.

**Sela**  
In jutri bo na naših računih še vedno pisalo, da smo izbrali vaš prah.
Jaro se je obrnil k njej.

**Jaro**  
Vedel sem, da je ta razvrstitev lažna. Kljub temu sem izterjeval, ker bi klinika ustavila Lijino zdravljenje.

**Sela**  
Razumevanje razloga ne vrne zraka, ki smo ga odmerjali.

**Jaro**  
Ne.
Illuminara je pogledala Jara.

**Illuminara**  
Lio je skozi ta oddelek nosila pladnje s tesnili. Povedal si nam za petkov polog na kliniki. Smem Niku povedati pot in kodo poškodbe?
Jaro je držal raztrgani trak.

**Jaro**  
Pot in kodo poškodbe. Ne njenih kartotek. Lio odloči, ali se njeno ime izreče.
Lio je odgovorila po povezavi z delavnico.

**Lio**  
Uporabi moje ime. Prejšnji mesec sem skozi ta oddelek nesla dvanajst pladnjev.
Niko je preveril dnevnik poti in Lijino kodo izpostavljenosti. Oba sta navajala linijo topil.
Illuminara je ob Nikov spekter položila prazni polji za seriji.

**Illuminara**  
Nocoj potrebujemo dva obnovljena naboja in enega rezervnega. Jutri potrebujemo pošteno razporeditev škode. Bo zadruga iz svoje vzdrževalne rezerve založila revidirano naročilo membran, medtem ko ta spekter vloži proti izvoznemu podjetju?
Niko je eno roko držal na rdečem drogu za zaustavitev.

**Niko**  
Moje posadke glasujejo pred prvo celo ploščo. Če zavrnejo, se naprava vrne k ležajem.

**Jaro**  
Začnite z raztrganim robom. Če je naš odgovor napačen, bo odpovedal, preden porabimo ploščo.

Plazma je čez tkanino naredila vijoličasto kožico. Niko jo je očistil, Jaro stisnil, Lio pa je iz delavnice spremljala sled napetosti. Pet prehodov je zdržalo. Prvo prazno polje na Jarovi tabli je postalo modro.

scenes.title: Ključ in glasovanje
paragraphs: *Vennova voda in pranje, javni hodnik · 21:18, dve uri in dvainštirideset minut pred prašnim viharjem*
Rudarji so odobrili predujem iz rezerve, toda mehanik po imenu Pell je stal pred kamero na hodniku, njegov glas proti pa je bil viden.

**Pell**  
Spekter dokazuje prah. Ne dokazuje, da nam bo izvozno podjetje povrnilo denar. Delal bom na plazemski liniji, vendar se ne bom pretvarjal, da je rezerva varna.

**Niko**  
Tvoj ugovor ostane v zapisniku.
Pred glasovanjem prebivalcev je Jaro vrata obdržal zaprta.

**Jaro**  
Če se odpovem ključavnici, kaj se zgodi, ko bo klinika v petek zahtevala Lijin polog? Ne nekoč. V petek.
Niko je podpisani spekter položil ob nalog za rezervo.

**Niko**  
Njena diagnosticirana poškodba pljuč je del istega zahtevka zaradi prahu. Z vašim soglasjem bo zadruga založila polog iz rezerve za nevarnosti in račun klinike vložila proti izvozni liniji. To ni dobrodelnost in ni plačilo za tvoj pristanek.

**Sela**  
In ne izbriše tega, kar si storil. Prepreči, da bi bil tvoj otrok poroštvo za to, kar so storili oni.
Jaro je pogledal Lio. Eno roko je imela na varnostni zapori, drugo pa v zakrpanem rokavu.

**Jaro**  
Potem javni službi izročim vrata, bobne in knjigo dolgov. Prosim za plačano delo po enakih varnostnih pravilih kot vsi drugi. Sele ne prosim, naj mi odpusti.
Iz predpasnika je vzel fizični ključ za premostitev in ga položil Lio v dlan. Lio je glavna vrata odprla, še preden je bil preštet prvi glas.

Prebivalci so javno službo odobrili; sedem družin se je do pravnega pregleda vzdržalo. Sela je glasovala za ohranitev Jarovega tehničnega dela in ob glas napisala NI ODPUŠČENO. Pellov glas proti je ostal v istem zapisniku.
Lio je snela napis o dolgu in ga kot dokaz položila z licem navzdol pod pult.

Obnovljeni katalizator je zagotovil tri dodatne naboje: dva, ki sta manjkala na Jarovi tabli, in enega rezervnega. Prebivalci so oblikovali vrste za pregled, pranje in tesnjenje. Nikove posadke so skozi tlačni predor pošiljale oštevilčene pladnje.
Ob 22:11 je dejavni naboj izgubil napetost.

**Jaro**  
Ustavite vse bobne.

Lio je zaprla varnostno zaporo. Vsak boben se je ustavil, preden je onesnažena voda prečkala tesnilo. Pell je stal ob javni tabli in glasno bral sled, medtem ko sta Jaro in Lio odpovedani naboj zamenjala z edinim obnovljenim rezervnim.

**Pell**  
Zaustavitev je delovala. Rezervni je sedemnajsti naboj in zdaj osemnajstega ni. Še vedno nasprotujem predujmu iz rezerve. To sled potrjujem.
Vse štiri serije so ostale zagotovljene, noben neuporabljen naboj pa ni ostal.
Lio je ob vrsti nosila svetilko za šive. Ob vsakem kolenu je uporabniku naročila, naj se skloni, obrne in seže proti namišljenemu zgornjemu ventilu.

Illuminara je delala pri najbolj umazanem bobnu. Ko je udaril predhodni naelektreni sunek, je držala izpušni razdelilnik dovolj dolgo, da ga je Jaro oprl. Njena moč je preprečila, da bi se cev pretrgala; ni pa spremenila javne vrste.

Ob 22:46 je obleka Selinega sina opravila pregled in modro rezervo je vrnil Lio, preden se je iztekla njena štiriurna zaloga. Ob 23:41 je pregled opravila oseminosemdeseta obleka. Zadnjih pet je pripadalo odraslim, ki so novejše vložke odstopili otrokom.
Jaro je dvignil zadnjo vrečo in našel Selino ime.

**Jaro**  
Tvoj račun je bil prvi, ki sem ga zaklenil.

**Sela**  
Potem ga operi, ker je naslednji, ne zato, ker od mene potrebuješ odvezo.

**Jaro**  
Ker je naslednji.

Ob 23:56 je triindevetdeseta obleka prestala tlačni preizkus. Vihar je udaril štiri minute pozneje. Družine so se zatekle v čiste obleke, medtem ko je Jaro stal ob ročni zaustavitvi, Sela ob vrsti, Niko ob tabli goseničarjev in Lio ob ključu javne službe.

scenes.title: Kar je pripadalo jutru
paragraphs: *Naselbina Kestrel, pred Vennovo vodo in pranjem · 07:32, po prašnem viharju*

Vihar je odluščil barvo s sten, obrnjenih proti rudniku, in vrt zakopal pod siv pesek. Nihče na hodniku ni izgubil tlaka. Triindevetdeset oblek je viselo označenih kot čiste, popravljene in v lasti ljudi, ki so jih nosili.

Po zamenjavi ob 22:11 ni ostal noben neuporabljen cikel naboja: vseh sedemnajst je bilo evidentiranih na javni tabli. Okrasna voda je ostala ustavljena štirinajst dni, izgubljenih dvainosemdeset litrov pa je šlo v počasno predelavo. Neuspeli preizkus je ostal v knjigi ob rezultatu, ki ga je kupil.

Niko je prinesel vlogo o odgovornosti za prah in potrdilo klinike za Lijin polog. Zadruga je zamrznila gospodinjsko razvrstitev in proti izvoznemu podjetju odprla merilni zahtevek. Arbitraža je ostala nerešena.

**Niko**  
Pravijo, da en spekter ni dokončen.

**Sela**  
Potem jim daj vsako izmeno.

**Niko**  
Začeli smo ob zori.
Odbor prebivalcev je Jaru ponudil enoletno pogodbo upravljavca, odpovedljivo zaradi kršitve varnosti ali izključevanja in plačano iz prihodka javne službe, ne iz gospodinjskega dolga.

**Jaro**  
Stroji niso moji.

**Sela**  
Tvoje znanje je. Zanj ti plačujemo.
Stara datoteka dolgov je ostala kot dokaz, vendar je bilo stanje vsakega gospodinjstva nič. Zdravstvene kartoteke so pred revizijo odstranili.

**Sela**  
Pomni, kaj se je zgodilo. Ne odloča več, kdo diha.
Jaro je podpisal. Ni prosil za stisk roke.
Lio je vklopila prvi boben za pranje klinike. Na nadzorni plošči je pisalo VODA, MEMBRANA, VIR PRAHU in VRSTA. Nobena vrstica ni pisala VREDEN.

**Lio**  
Rokav še vedno vleče pri zgornjem ventilu.

**Illuminara**  
Tretji šiv je popravil raztrganino, ne dosega.
Tokrat je obroč držala Sela. Lio je dodala polmesec prožne tkanine, medtem ko jo je Jaro opazoval, ne da bi popravljal njene roke. Ko se je stegnila, se je rokav premaknil z njo.
Zunaj so prebivalci vrt čistili s suhimi ščetkami, medtem ko so se pod odprtimi vrati kopičila obvestila o arbitraži.
Illuminara je odšla, ko se je zavrtelo prvo običajno pranje. Za njo so vrata ostala odprta; Sela je držala obroč rokava, medtem ko je Lio segla do zgornjega ventila, ne da bi novi polmesec vlekel.

translation_sl.critic_line: Illuminara iz neuspelega preizkusa razbere nežnejšo pot, očeta in hčer prosi za dovoljenje, da izreče tisto, kar lahko povesta le onadva, zaklenjena pralnica pa se pred prihodom prahu spremeni v odprto javno službo s triindevetdesetimi čistimi oblekami.

late_publication.reason: Published later, on 11 November 2026, by BD's decision. The 21:00 day freeze for 10 November was never created, so the nightly publisher held the day. All three stories, their critic closes, Slovenian translations and independent reader scores were complete and unchanged before the 20:30 cutoff. Claude also wrote story S2 as a recorded stand-in for GPT.
late_publication.reason_sl: Objavljeno naknadno, 11. novembra 2026, po BD-jevi odločitvi. Zamrznitev dneva ob 21:00 za 10. november ni nastala, zato je nočni objavljalnik dan zadržal. Vse tri zgodbe, zaključki kritikov, slovenski prevodi in neodvisni bralski oceni so bili popolni in nespremenjeni pred rezom ob 20:30. Zgodbo S2 je kot zapisano nadomestilo za GPT napisal tudi Claude.
